results.text: Glipizide in the treatment of maturity-onset diabetes: a multi-centre, out-patient study. A multi-centre clinical assessment was carried out in 592 diabetic patients to study the efficacy and tolerance of glipizide under normal out-patient conditions. Of the total group, 347 patients were maturity-onset diabetics who had received no previous treatment or only dietary control.
